# OscillatoryDynamicsOptimization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A multi-objective optimization method that leverages oscillatory dynamics in spiking neural systems to explore trade-offs between conflicting objectives. Provides a biologically inspired alternative to gradient-based optimization, potentially enabling energy-efficient and parallel search in neuromorphic hardware.
